episodes.question: Is there a gap between what I say and how I actually live?
episodes.quote: Better than a thousand meaningless statements is one meaningful word which, having been heard, brings peace.

episodes.title: The Freedom Beyond Anger
episodes.subtitle: Peace of mind that is not dependent on anyone else
episodes.about: Listen now | Take A Pause Ep. 89: Peace of mind that is not dependent on anyone else | Non-hate sits closer with the choice of not picking at our own wounds.
episodes.question: Can I meet this person or situation I don't like with greater ease?
episodes.quote: Hatred never ends through hatred. By non-hate alone does it end.

episodes.title: The Mind Leads the Way
episodes.subtitle: How thoughts shape our experiences
episodes.about: Take A Pause Ep. 88: How thoughts shape our experiences
episodes.quote: The mind is a natural storyteller — constantly predicting, replaying, catastrophising, judging, comparing, often before we've finished our coffee.

episodes.title: The Capacity to Remain Balanced
episodes.subtitle: Staying grounded no matter how the winds blow
episodes.about: Listen now | Take A Pause Ep. 87: Staying grounded no matter how the winds blow | A life with equanimity is not absent of disruption...
episodes.quote: Balance is not standing still. It is the quiet inner strength that allows us to respond wisely.

episodes.title: Uncovering a Friendly Heart
episodes.subtitle: What unconditional goodwill means
episodes.about: Listen now | Take A Pause Ep. 86: What unconditional goodwill means. A friendly heart is one that learns to wish well, even when life feels difficult.
episodes.quote: To practise metta is to remember that beneath our defences, there is still a friendly heart waiting to be uncovered.

episodes.title: Committing Wholeheartedly
episodes.subtitle: Holding steady when things get hard
episodes.about: Listen now | Take A Pause Ep. 85: Holding steady when things get hard | Cultivating aditthana, or strong determination

episodes.title: Being Real and Honest
episodes.subtitle: A practice of living in alignment with reality
episodes.about: Listen now | Take A Pause Ep. 84: A practice of living in alignment with reality | There's a quality of heart called sacca...
episodes.question: Am I who I appear to be?

episodes.title: The Strength to Stay
episodes.subtitle: Patience as a quiet power
episodes.about: Listen now | Take A Pause Ep. 83: Patience as a quiet power | The point is this: no matter what comes at you, the heart can be protected.
episodes.question: What are the saws in your life right now?
episodes.quote: It is the capacity to stay. To stay when things don't go your way. To stay without collapsing, without retaliating, and without running away.

episodes.title: Steady, Sustainable Effort
episodes.subtitle: A wiser relationship with our energy
episodes.about: Listen now | Take A Pause Ep. 82: A wiser relationship with our energy. Overtime, sustained effort becomes a quiet strength.
episodes.question: What is worth giving my energy to? What drains me unnecessarily?
episodes.quote: Awakening, healing, and growth rarely happen through one dramatic breakthrough. More often than not, they are the fruit of choosing to show up, one breath, one step, one day at a time.

episodes.title: Seeing Things Clearly
episodes.subtitle: Wisdom is not the same as intelligence.
episodes.about: Take A Pause Ep. 81: Wisdom is not the same as intelligence.
episodes.quote: Wisdom is the ability to see things clearly.
